cover_title: Dekh Ke Khush Mat Ho Jao
cover_sub: Online sales me fake discounts se bachne ke 5 simple smart tricks.

slides.heading: MRP Badha Ke Discount
slides.body: Sale se thode din pehle MRP badha di jaati hai aur phir uspar bada discount dikhaya jaata hai. Asli price change nahi hota.
slides.tip: Sirf percentage discount mat dekho, final price check karo.

slides.heading: Price History Check Karo
slides.body: Price tracker tools se check karo ki product pehle kitne me bik raha tha. Isse pata chalega discount sach me real hai ya nahi.
slides.tip: Sale se 1 mahine pehle ki price zaroor compare karo.

slides.heading: Doosri Sites Pe Compare Karo
slides.body: Ek hi platform pe blind trust mat karo. Same item doosri shopping apps par search karo, wahan price kam ho sakti hai.
slides.tip: Sabhi major shopping apps par price zaroor dekho.

slides.heading: Seller Rating Aur Reviews
slides.body: Bada discount dekh kar bina rating check kiye order mat karo. Naye ya kam rating wale sellers aksar nakli deals dikhate hain.
slides.tip: Hamesha top-rated sellers se hi khareedari karo.

slides.heading: Final Coupon Price Dekho
slides.body: Checkout page tak jao aur bank offers ya app coupons apply karke dekho. Real discount checkout par hi samajh aata hai.
slides.tip: Payment karne se pehle sabhi available coupons lagao.
